title: Preparation, Properties and Uses of Benzene
topicTitle: Preparation of benzene from decarboxylation of sodium benzoate, phenol, and ethyne only; physical properties of benzene; chemical properties of benzene; combustion of benzene (free combustion only) and uses
notes: **Decarboxylation of sodium benzoate:** $C_6H_5COONa + NaOH \xrightarrow{CaO, \Delta} C_6H_6 + Na_2CO_3$.
**Physical properties:** colourless liquid, aromatic odour, immiscible with water, density 0.88 g/mL, boiling point 80Â°C.

**Electrophilic substitution:** benzene substitutes rather than adds to preserve aromaticity. Nitration, sulphonation, halogenation, Friedel-Crafts alkylation and acylation all proceed via electrophilic attack.
**Uses:** solvent for fats, oils, resins; precursor to styrene, nylon, phenol, aniline; component of petrol.
